findings.evidence: Page 68 §3.3.2: "subtract an assumed ~1.4B always-on block ... from the 46.7B total and divide the remainder across 8 experts — 45.3B ÷ 8 ≈ 5.7B per expert ... use the component-derived ~47B / ~12.8B (2 × 5.7B routed experts + ~1.4B always-on); the component sum sits 0.1B below the published 12.9B active count"
findings.issue: The arithmetic is internally inconsistent: 46.7B − 1.4B = 45.3B; 45.3B + 1.4B = 46.7B, not the ~47B used in Table 3-2 and throughout the chapter. The text acknowledges the active-count discrepancy (12.8B vs 12.9B) but not the total-parameter discrepancy. The ~47B total is carried into Table 3-2, Table 3-3, Fig 3.4, and the mini-case, so downstream percentages (active/total ~27%, residency ~94 GB) inherit the rounded-up total rather than the published 46.7B.
findings.fix_instruction: Either state the component-derived total as ~46.7B (and recompute 12.8/46.7 ≈ 27.4%, 94/140 etc.), or explicitly note that 5.7B is a rounded per-expert figure and that the ~47B total is a rounded illustrative value that does not sum to the published 46.7B. Align Table 3-2, Table 3-3, Fig 3.4, and §3.8 with the corrected total.

findings.evidence: The dense-70B column traces to the canonical scenario (Ch 4, Table 4-2); the MoE column carries [ILLUSTRATIVE] provenance with the per-row [ASSUMPTION]/[DERIVED] split shown in its derivation column — the same tags Table 3-2 gives the same quantities — and it is a worked variant, not a measurement claim.
findings.issue: The evidence labels in Table 3-2 (and consequently Table 3-3) are systematically malformed. For every derived value in these tables (e.g. 'FP16 residency (total) 140 GB', 'FLOPs per token ~0.14T'), the derivation column contains only the calculation text ('2 × 80 × 8192 × 2 B = ...'). The text claims these quantities have an '[ASSUMPTION]/[DERIVED] split shown in its derivation column', but no such split or tags are present in the actual tables for the derived rows. The [DERIVED] tag is completely omitted, rendering the provenance ledger incomplete and contradicting the text's assertion.
findings.fix_instruction: Add [DERIVED] tags to all arithmetic results in the derivation columns of Table 3-2 and Table 3-3, ensuring they match the [canonical scenario][DERIVED] or [ILLUSTRATIVE][DERIVED] format used elsewhere in the book.
